meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目结构、命令与规范沉淀成分级指南,让 AI 代理快速理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 编程助手准确理解你的项目结构和开发约定。
copy.tagline_en: Turn repo structure, commands, and conventions into a layered guide for AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI coding agents to understand your project's structure, commands, and conventions.

howto.what: 它会扫描项目目录、代码符号和已有文档,在根目录和复杂度较高的子目录生成分层 AGENTS.md,记录项目结构、命令和约定,供 agent 使用。
howto.when: 当一个仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录下来给 agent 用时触发;在项目里运行 /init-deep 即可,可选更新模式或 --create-new、--max-depth 等参数。

say.note: 在项目根目录生成或更新分层 AGENTS.md
先读旧文件再删除,从头重新生成
把目录深度限制为 2 层

howto.what_en: It scans your repo's directories, code symbols, and existing docs, then writes layered AGENTS.md files at the root and in complex subdirectories, covering project structure, commands, and conventions for agents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents. Run /init-deep; options include update mode, --create-new, and --max-depth.

say_en.note: Generate or update layered AGENTS.md in the repo root
Read old files, delete them, regenerate from scratch
